finalText:
**Build is clean.** Exit 0, `0 errors`.

Two real bugs, both from the bump, not noise:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to match.
- [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats undefined as disabled.

The rest is deprecation noise from the dependency bump, deliberate and harmless.

Next: nothing.
